lawFindings.issue: A sale of an apartment registered in the land book must be made in authentic form before a notary; a private signed contract is absolutely void and cannot be registered.

Excluding the eviction guarantee does not free the seller from returning the price, unless the buyer bought at her own risk, and the seller always answers for eviction caused by its own act or by causes it hid.
The exclusion of liability for hidden defects is void for the bathroom leaks the seller knows about and did not disclose.
A 2% daily penalty on the whole price with no cap, and a ban on the court reducing it: the court may reduce a manifestly excessive penalty and any contrary clause is deemed unwritten.
Claims about rights in a building go only to the court where the building is located (Bucharest, sector 6); this exclusive jurisdiction cannot be changed by agreement.

lawfulClauses.why: Ownership passes when the contract is concluded, even before delivery or full payment, unless the parties agree otherwise.
The tax on income from transferring a property is owed by the seller as taxpayer.

otherMistakes.issue: Two originals for the parties, while a land book registration would also need a copy for the registry.

lawFindings.issue: A company from a non-EU state may acquire land in Romania only under international treaties and on reciprocity; the parties cannot agree that no restriction applies.
When the party that received the deposit refuses to perform, the other party may ask for double the deposit (or for performance or damages); returning only the deposit removes that right.
In a promise to sell, the party facing an unjustified refusal may ask the court for a ruling that takes the place of the sale contract, within 6 months.

lawfulClauses.why: The final sale of land is made in authentic form before a notary, as required for land book rights.

notCovered.why: Pre-emption rights of the tenant farmer, neighbours and the State on agricultural land outside towns come from Law 17/2014, which this pack does not include.

otherMistakes.issue: The land is handed over free of crops by 31 March 2027, yet the seller keeps the rent for the 2026–2027 farming year, while a tenant farmer still works the land.

lawFindings.issue: Fixed hours at the client's office, daily tasks and leave set by a manager, a fixed monthly sum and the client's equipment describe dependent work under an employer's authority, which requires a written individual employment contract.
A 5-year non-compete covering all of Romania and the EU with no payment: if the relationship is employment, a non-compete needs a monthly indemnity, a limited area and lasts at most 2 years.
Recording the screen, keystrokes and webcam all day without prior information or consultation fails the conditions for electronic monitoring of workers.

Standard terms allowing termination without notice, excluding the defence of non-performance and choosing the arbitrator are unusual clauses that bind only if the other party accepts them expressly in writing.

lawfulClauses.why: Liability may be limited by contract, except for damage caused intentionally or by gross negligence, which the clause keeps.

notCovered.why: Transfer of copyright in software is governed by Law 8/1996 on copyright, which this pack does not include.

otherMistakes.issue: A PFA invoices a gross amount and pays its own taxes (clause 2.2), so a "net" monthly fee is ambiguous.

lawFindings.issue: A probation period of 180 days for an execution role; the maximum is 90 calendar days.
60-hour weeks for three months exceed the 48-hour weekly maximum, including overtime, and overtime must be compensated with paid time off or a pay supplement.
Annual leave must be taken each year and may be paid in cash only when the contract ends; an employee cannot waive it.
The resignation notice for an execution role may not exceed 20 working days, and an employee answers only for actual damage caused through fault, not a fixed penalty.
An employee cannot waive rights granted by law, including the right to challenge dismissal or sanctions in court; such a waiver is void.

lawfulClauses.why: 21 working days of annual leave is above the 20-day legal minimum.
A dismissal notice of at least 20 working days matches the legal minimum.
The contract is written, in Romanian, and registered before work starts.

otherMistakes.issue: The clause says the employer may end the contract without notice during probation but is silent on the employee's equal right.

lawFindings.issue: A tenant of a home may end a fixed-term lease with at least 60 days' notice; a clause that forbids it or charges the remaining rent is deemed unwritten.

The landlord must make the repairs needed to keep the home usable; only minor repairs from ordinary use fall on the tenant, so roof, heating and structural repairs cannot all be pushed onto the tenant without a rent deduction.
A lease registered with the tax authority is by law an enforcement title for the rent; the parties cannot remove that effect.
Entering the home at any time without notice breaches the landlord's duty to ensure the tenant's quiet use of the home.

lawfulClauses.why: On tacit renewal the new lease is indefinite unless the parties agree otherwise, so they may fix a new term in advance.
The tenant may sublet or assign unless this is expressly forbidden, which the clause does.

otherMistakes.issue: No deadline for returning the deposit after the lease ends.
